statusLine.command: input=$(cat | tr -d '\n'); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"display_name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n1); used=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed 's/.*"context_window"//' | grep -o '"used_percentage"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[^,}]*' | head -n1 | sed 's/.*:[[:space:]]*//'); branch=$(git --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$model"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf ' \033[32m%s\033[0m' "$branch"; case "$used" in ''|null) ;; *) pct=${used%.*}; c=32; [ "$pct" -ge 50 ] && c=33; [ "$pct" -ge 80 ] && c=31; printf ' \033[%sm ctx %s%%\033[0m' "$c" "$pct";; esac
